SYMPTOM: Maestro tests using `id: keyboard.brandLabel`, `id: keyboard.micButton` etc. all fail — elements not found
CAUSE: Maestro reads accessibility TEXT across process boundaries for extensions, but not programmatic accessibilityIdentifiers
FIX: Replace all `id:` selectors with `label:` text matching:
  - `id: keyboard.brandLabel` → `label: Whisnap`
  - `id: keyboard.micButton` → `label: waveform`  
  - `id: keyboard.shiftKey` → `label: Shift`
  - `id: keyboard.deleteKey` → `label: Delete`
  - `id: keyboard.spaceKey` → `label: Space`
  - `id: keyboard.returnKey` → `label: Return`
  - Letter keys: lowercase only — `label: q`, `label: w` (NOT 'Q', 'W')
PREVENT: Never use `id:` selectors for keyboard extension elements in Maestro flows — always use `label:`
